rationale: Register two test targets in test/cmake/view_widget_bridge_tests.cmake and guard seven trusted-host launch cases on PULP_TEST_WITH_SANITIZER. A sanitizer build links libclang_rt.*_osx_dynamic.dylib into every launched child, which the trusted-host runtime-closure policy correctly rejects as an unpinned foreign image, so those cases can only report a false red on the sanitizer lane. The production policy in inspect/src/control_trusted_host_inventory.cpp is deliberately unchanged — relaxing it would delete the property under test — and the guarded cases still run and still gate on every non-sanitizer lane. No visual-proof, screenshot, capture, or harness behavior is altered; the touched file is a test-registration manifest.
tests: the runtime-closure sanitizer guard matches this build (asserts the skip fires under PULP_TEST_WITH_SANITIZER and does NOT fire otherwise; confirmed by inverting the guard and observing failure in both directions)
